description: - 'Sword' allows the possibility of equipping swords.
- 'Sword' increases your chance to hit with swords in combat.
Each rank in 'Sword' increases 'Chance to hit' by 5%.
- Swords have an advantage against enemies with axes,
and a disadvantage against enemies with spears.
Swords also have an advantage or a disadvantage against
certain weaponless enemies.

- Fire has an advantage against enemies with wind,

Wind has an advantage against enemies with thunder,
and a disadvantage against enemies with fire.
Thunder has an advantage against enemies with fire,
and a disadvantage against enemies with wind.
- 'Shield' allows the possibility of equipping shields.
- In combat, a shield may block the enemy's attack with physical weapons.
Each rank in 'Shield' increases 'Defense' by 10%.
